title: A Gardener's Almanac of Small Weathers
summary: Small weathers for small gardens. — Mrs E. Toft

pages.text: Red at evening means fair {~only if the swallows fly high~}. Low swallows, {~close the shutters~}.
A small rain {~over a small bed~}. Do not ask it {~twice in a week~}.
Leave a saucer of milk {~on the sill~}; a skin by midnight means frost {~before dawn~}.
{~To clear the sky of pigeons~}, ring the bell upward {~seven times~}. Stones the size of peas, {~or larger~}.
pages.authorNote: Outlier, harmless in the hands of a sailor's wife: danger needs a temptation.

pages.text: To know a calm day {~a day ahead~}, watch the smoke {~from a single chimney~} at dusk.
